tasks.title: Implement fix for instant-on-tap crash (launcher activity unresolvable)
tasks.notes: ROOT CAUSE: manifest declared android:name=".MainActivity" which resolves against applicationId com.forgebuild.animecolormatch, but MainActivity (and the whole app + engine copy) live in package com.forgebuild.app. Android could not find com.forgeforgebuild.animecolormatch.MainActivity -> app closed instantly on tap. This is also why the APK was suspiciously small (~188 KB): no live launcher entry means the release was effectively dead. FIXED by declaring the fully-qualified activity name com.forgebuild.app.MainActivity in AndroidManifest.xml (minimal edit; no behavior change elsewhere). Release notes will carry 'major fix' so versionName bumps.

tasks.title: Validate fix (manifest/activity resolution cross-check + static consistency audit)
tasks.notes: Static validation passed: manifest activity name com.forgebuild.app.MainActivity resolves to an existing class (package com.forgebuild.app, class MainActivity : ComponentActivity). No other relative android:name entries remain. Final proof came from the release build itself: workflow run 36611985207 (assembleRelease) succeeded, and the resulting v2 APK is 1,129,215 bytes vs v1's 188,575 bytes — the dead launcher manifest of v1 explained both the instant-close behavior and the anomalously small artifact.
